description:
Cute Halloween cat on a rooftop under a giant golden moon, with fun little animations all around it.

[list]
[*] The cat breathes, its tail sways and flicks, and now and then it turns to look right at you with a slow blink. Sniffs, licks, ear flicks, a sigh.
[*] A little sheet ghost plays hide and seek behind the chimney: peek, duck, pop up, wave, giggle.
[*] A witch and her cat fly across the moon, trailing sparkles.
[*] Tiny ghosts carry lanterns up to the castle and its windows turn ghostly blue.
[*] Will-o'-wisps rise from the lake and go out one by one.
[*] Bats flit by.
[*] Always on: chimney smoke, swaying trees, blinking town windows, a jack-o'-lantern throwing sparks, drifting clouds, ivy leaves that fall and grow back.
[/list]
Something new drops by about every half minute.

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ghosts & witch: how often the ghosts, the witch and the bats come by. 0 = never, 50 = about every half minute, 100 = one after another, no breaks.
[*] Leaves: how often ivy leaves fall. 25 or less = none, 0 = the ivy holds still too.
[*] Clouds: how fast the clouds drift. 0 = still.
[*] Lights: the town's windows and the jack-o'-lantern. 0 = dark.
[/list]
50 is the tuned look. Brightness, contrast and colour are Wallpaper Engine's own options.

title: Moon Cat - Cute Halloween Night
